qualification: local pinned-fixture diagnostics evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

diagnosticChange.source: decoder-confirmed bytes retained by each live negative-cache entry at publication
diagnosticChange.scope: The field describes only the capped live-entry sample at the last completed coarse sample or normal terminal slice; it is not a cumulative histogram.
diagnosticChange.purpose: Identify ASLR-dependent and alternatives-patched hot sites without inferring live code from a static address.

verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,492 tests in 175 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.projectionCoverage: Runner JSON tests assert that instruction bytes are present and remain within the bounded diagnostic size.

interpretation: Live byte capture resolves the formerly unidentified dominant userspace site as xchg eax,edx and creates a byte-stable acceptance target across ASLR runs. It also distinguishes live alternatives-patched kernel bytes from the static image.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and its sites are live-entry observations rather than cumulative reason totals.
This diagnostics-only slice establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
